description_en: Command prefix that wraps shell commands Claude Code spawns: Bash tool calls, [hook](/en/hooks) commands, and stdio [MCP server](/en/mcp) startup commands. Useful for logging or auditing. Example: setting `/path/to/logger.sh` runs each command as `/path/to/logger.sh <command>`
description_ja: Claude Codeが起動するすべてのシェルコマンド(ツール呼び出し、フック、MCPサーバー)に付与するコマンド接頭辞を設定します。

related_changelog.content: - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX` for wrapping Claude and user-provided shell commands run by Claude Code
